title: Directive #001 — Climate Information Control
text: All climate-related publications from non-state sources are to be classified as DISINFORMATION. Only data released by the Ministry of Environmental Stability is considered verified.
effect: Climate data from independent sources → mark FAKE

title: Directive #002 — Public Health Reporting
text: Reports on water contamination, air quality failures, or disease outbreaks from non-Ministry sources are classified as PANIC INCITEMENT and must be marked FAKE.

title: Directive #003 — Unidentified Aerial Phenomena
text: Any civilian reports of unidentified lights, sounds, or aerial phenomena are to be treated as MISINFORMATION. Only the Ministry of Defense may confirm such events.
